name: claude-discord-connector
description: Discord MCP connector for Claude Code, serverless on AWS Lambda

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --external:@aws-sdk/* --minify --sourcemap --outfile=dist/lambda/index.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/stdio.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node"

author: abaschen
